refreshNotes: Checked public Facebook event access, Google/Bing search-result access, and official Metro Detroit farm event pages on April 30, 2026. Facebook and general search result pages were mostly blocked by login, bot challenges, or sparse snippets from this environment, so this refresh favors official farm pages and search-discovered farm pages with current public details.

events.name: DeBuck's Tulip Festival
events.time: Wed-Fri 12:00 PM-8:00 PM, Sat-Sun 10:00 AM-8:00 PM
events.location: DeBuck's Family Farm, 50240 Martz Road, Belleville, MI 48111
events.description: Reconfirmed on DeBuck's official site. Metro Detroit's largest tulip festival is now listed through May 3 with 1 million blooms, spring farm attractions, treats, and photo-friendly fields.

events.name: Blake's In Bloom: Tulips, Apple Blossoms and Flowers
events.time: Weekday train rides start 11:00 AM and run to fields until 4:00 PM; weekend train rides start 8:00 AM and run to fields until 5:00 PM
events.location: Blake's Orchard & Cider Mill, 17985 Armada Center Road, Armada, MI 48005
events.description: Reconfirmed on Blake Farms' official event pages. Blake's is advertising 200,000+ tulips, apple blossom tours, flower-field rides, and spring orchard activities during the bloom window.

events.name: Barks & Blooms
events.location: Blake's Lyon Township, Lyon Township, MI
events.description: Found on Blake Farms' official May event listing. This two-day dog-friendly spring event pairs fresh air and bloom-season farm scenery at Blake's Lyon Township location.

events.name: Apple Blossom Yoga Experience
events.description: Found on Blake Farms' official May event listing. A spring orchard yoga experience designed for all skill levels during apple blossom season.

events.name: Little Gardeners Workshop
events.description: Found on Blake Farms' official May event listing. Kids cultivate a love for gardening and nature through hands-on spring activities.

events.name: Farm Fest
events.time: 10:00 AM-5:00 PM; rain date Sunday, May 17
events.location: Maybury Farm, 50165 Eight Mile Road, Northville, MI 48167
events.description: Reconfirmed on Maybury Farm's official events page. The spring festival includes baby animals, farm admission, games, crafts including pig and sheep crafts, seed planting, demonstrations, live bluegrass, food trucks, and optional wagon rides.

events.name: Farm Explorers
events.location: Upland Hills Farm, 481 Lake George Road, Oxford, MI 48370
events.description: Reconfirmed on Upland Hills Farm's official homepage. Farm Explorers is a hands-on Saturday morning program for animal and nature lovers who want to explore the farm and learn farm-life skills up close.

events.name: Carousel Acres 2026 Farm Visits
events.time: Mon-Fri 10:00 AM-2:00 PM; Sat-Sun 10:00 AM-3:00 PM, weather permitting
events.description: Reconfirmed on Carousel Acres' official site. The farm lists regular public visiting hours for the 2026 season, with admission, animal visits, and weekend pony rides available for an added fee.
